description: Estimated GRE verbal and quant scores on the 130 to 170 scale: 130 plus the fraction of questions correct times 40, per section, plus the total. The optional writing score is clamped to 0 to 6 as on the page. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive GRE Score Estimator calculator.
name: calculate_gre_score_estimator
